info.name: DeepDental API
info.description:
REST API for DeepDental AI-powered teledentistry assistant.

## Authentication
All endpoints require `X-API-Key` header.

## Quick Start
1. Set your `api_key` in the environment
2. Call 'Create Session' - session_id will be auto-saved
3. Use any Chat or Image endpoint - all data is auto-captured

## Auto-Save Features
- session_id: Auto-saved on Create Session
- last_message_id: Auto-saved on Chat responses
- All environment variables are validated before requests

## Dentist Portal Hardening Update (2026-05-07)
Dentist portal browser traffic must use the application backend proxy. Direct Postman calls still use X-API-Key. Runtime dentist flows use role=dentist and language=id. Image reasoning uses /images/analyze; /analysis/from-detections is the formal contract for detector-output handoff.

Verified Case Workspace endpoints were added on 2026-05-07 for clinical case workflows: multi-image upload, quality checks, AI-assisted findings, clinician confirmation, audit, exports, timeline linkage, and session-case linkage.
